description: adws/adw_interface_company_todos.py -- read_request -> apply_change -> report. Reads the user's sentence as add / list / done with pattern rules (lancedb_memory/company_todos/requests.py), applies it to the append-only list, and writes one line to --message-out. An unclear request, a 'don't', or a check-off matching more than one item changes nothing and says so.
